title: The Siletz Coast Signal
hook: Did a phantom light guide ships off Oregon's coast?
headline: Mysterious flashing beacon on Oregon shore

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: Fishermen reported a bright flashing light near Siletz Point.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: A Coast Guard log noted intermittent pulses lasting several seconds.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Marine biologists recorded unusual bioluminescent algae blooms near the site.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: A Navy sonar report suggested the flashes matched a buoy's distress beacon.

end.line: Could hidden military tests explain the phantom flashes?

description: Explore the mysterious flashing signal reported off Oregon's Siletz Coast.
